bio.text: Kyra Hoffner was elected to the Delaware Senate in 2022 to represent the 14th District, succeeding Sen. Bruce Ennis.
Hoffner was raised on Long Island, graduated from Patchogue-Medford High School in 1988, and moved to Delaware in 2001, where she worked in the mortgage industry until retiring in 2008.
Before the Senate, Hoffner was an advocate and volunteer coordinator for the Delaware Advocacy Network and a lobbyist for the League of Women Voters.
